title: RIL GET 2027 - E&I preparation blueprint
important_disclaimer: All priority values below are internal preparation recommendations derived from public candidate reports plus established Instrumentation curriculum. They are not official RIL weights and must not be labelled as expected percentages in the actual exam.

training_mix_default.label: Editable practice mix only — not an official RIL weighting.

priority_bands.reason: Frequently mentioned in current/previous candidate reports and/or core instrumentation curriculum
topics: Quantitative aptitude: percentages, ratios, averages, rates, time/work, speed/distance
Logical reasoning: series, coding, deduction, directions, data interpretation
Industrial measurement: pressure, temperature, flow, level
Control systems: feedback, PID basics, process variables
Project/internship discussion for later interview readiness

priority_bands.reason: Core degree fundamentals and NPTEL course coverage
topics: RTD, thermocouple, thermistor, strain gauge, LVDT
Calibration, error, accuracy, precision, sensitivity, hysteresis
Differential pressure, orifice, Venturi, magnetic, Coriolis and ultrasonic flowmeter principles
Control valves, positioners, fail-state decision logic
Analog circuits, op-amps, ADC/DAC, filters, digital logic
P&ID symbols and ISA-style instrument tags
Dynamic response/time constant, transfer functions and sampling
Advanced metrology details, communication nuances, safety lifecycle concepts
Extra non-verbal reasoning and verbal inference
